rows.decision_procedure: Step 1b Q1 no. Q2 yes: T is made directly from X's data: the fire pixels detected in the VJ114IMG_NRT Level 2 swath files (FP_latitude, FP_longitude, FP_T4, FP_T5, FP_power, confidence, ...) are converted to vector point records (TXT/SHP/KML/WMS by FIRMS) -> derived_from (PARENT; format conversion and subsetting, not aggregation). PARENT vs INPUT: reprocessing VJ114IMG_NRT changes every fire record in T.
